selected.definition: E_corr = image energy of the source - q * alignment; the level shift is the fixed-ion derivative of E_corr

warnings: Alignment shell has only 472 grid points; use a finer grid or wider shell.
No carrier orbital (--state-cube): the image source is the D-C response density, the response-density model, which is not the image energy of the bare carrier.

conventions.energy_correction: E_corr = E_iso - E_per; add to the raw charged-cell energy.
conventions.charging_model_check: C = median_far[(V_H(D)-V_H(C)) - phi_per_bare]; diagnostic only, not applied.
conventions.neutral_pipeline: Selected recipe: AB (auto/ab), AC (ac only) or image-only (none); other candidates are diagnostic.

isolated_solver.kernel: erf(s/a)/s sampled on the grid plus the analytic Fourier transform of erfc(s/a)/s

energies.charging_model_residual_reason: Consistency diagnostic only; not added to E_corr or V_cor.

radial.response_metric_interpretation: |delta rho| radii include carrier and polarisation; use state cubes for localisation.

planar.note: Defect-centred frame; edge mismatch = opposite-edge difference of the open-boundary field.

isolated_solver.kernel: erf(s/a)/s sampled on the grid plus the analytic Fourier transform of erfc(s/a)/s

density_alignment.reference_registration_note: AB: energy recipe; AC: direct C-to-A eigenvalue reference; DA_model: charged cell referenced to the host directly.

carrier.reason: no carrier orbital supplied: the charge is taken as localised and its image correction applies; supply --state-cube to test this
carrier.response_density_ratio_note: reported only: the response density carries the uniform compensation charge, so this ratio does not measure localisation

image_source.scope: D-C response density (screened charge plus uniform compensation) under the supplied dielectric: the response-density model, not the image energy of the bare carrier

pad_scan.note: pad scan absent or too short

response_extent.interpretation: response extent includes carrier and polarisation; use state cubes for localisation

sensitivity.interpretation: shell-bound sensitivity of the D-C model-check constant; diagnostic only
